name: headroom
description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
one_liner: A tool that shrinks the logs, files, and search results fed into an AI model before it sees them, cutting the token bill without changing the answers it gives.
buyer: A startup running high-volume AI agent pipelines (coding agents, RAG search, customer support bots) watching their LLM API bill climb every month.
business_use_cases: A startup with expensive multi-agent pipelines drops it in front of their existing LLM calls and immediately cuts their monthly API spend.
A RAG/search product wraps it around their retrieval layer to pass more context per dollar without hitting context-window limits.
A cost-optimization consultancy audits clients' AI pipelines and installs it as the first, highest-ROI fix before touching anything else.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'cut your LLM bill' audit that benchmarks a client's current spend against a Headroom-equipped setup, priced as a cut of the savings.
Build a hosted proxy version so non-technical teams get the savings without integrating a library themselves.

steal_this: Benchmark one client's current agent logs/token spend this weekend, drop Headroom in front of it, and show them the before/after bill — then price your fee as a percentage of what you saved them.
